parts.name: NFC U216 complete native assembled shell

notes: All 3616 triangles of the complete assembled native shell retained at scale 1 with one common translation of Z -1.2 mm. Components 1/2 are displaced separate shell copies (1888/1728 triangles). Native mounting bores, rear screw recess, front Grove cutout and top pry notch retained; no fills, cuts, scale or independent shell registration. PCB, ST25R3916, planar copper winding, matching passives, fastening metal and Grove interior reconstructed separately. Concealed board/component/antenna dimensions, turns and registration are visual inferences, not a production assembly or measured RF design.
